# Heading

A heading whose font, weight and letter spacing come from tokens. Use Page for page titles and Section for
group titles; use Heading on its own only in other places.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Titles in dialogs, drawers and custom areas

## Import

```ts
import { Heading } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Use Page for page titles and Section for groups; use Heading directly only in custom areas.

```tsx
import { Heading, Stack } from 'vellum-ui'

export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Stack gap={2}>
      <Heading level={2}>Block title</Heading>
      <Heading level={3}>Subsection title</Heading>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | `1 \| 2 \| 3` | Heading level: 1 for the page title (usually rendered by Page), 2 for block titles, 3 for subsection titles. | `2` | No |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | Heading text. | — | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
